reason: DREAM already has the exact leadership Kenneth sells as fractional -- Wayne Leung, Managing Director of IT since 2018, sits on the executive management team 'responsible for driving technology, cybersecurity, and systems strategies across the organization' (wearedream.org/our-leadership; Equilar ExecAtlas), backed by an in-house IT Department Manager and an IT Infrastructure Manager, so the 'no technology leadership, IT outsourced to vendors nobody oversees' situation does not exist; the org is also far too large for a fractional governance engagement (478 employees, $53.1M revenue FY24, scaling to a $98M budget) and is a tuition-free public charter, so the enrollment/tuition-attrition EDP does not apply; finally there is no quotable line -- the only live matched job is 'Associate Director of Program Data and Analytics,' a program-evaluation role reporting to the Senior Director of Data and Assessment ('creating effective systems for data collection, reporting, and analysis'), which is analytics capacity, not technology governance, and today's full ATS feed is entirely coaches, enrichment specialists, teachers and youth workers with zero IT, security, or governance roles.
